I'll pull up your recent training to answer this from what you've logged. Nothing is logged in the app for the last 12 weeks, and no active program shows up either, so I can't check your numbers for signs of a stall or fatigue. Going on what you've told me, eight weeks of hard training is right around when a lighter week starts to pay off.

The signs that you need one are lifts stalling or sliding for two sessions or more, warm-ups feeling heavy, sleep or motivation dropping, and the same weights feeling harder than they did a few weeks ago. If you're hitting those, take a week at roughly the same exercises with about half the sets and a few reps left in the tank on everything. If you feel good and the bar is still moving, you can keep going and deload when the signs show up.

How have your last couple of weeks felt, and have any lifts stopped moving?
